# Provenance of aleppo-pages/

`aleppo/aleppo-pages/` held 37 JPEG images of Aleppo Codex pages until 2026-09-26, when
[`../doc/PLAN-retire-codex-index-image-work.md`](../doc/PLAN-retire-codex-index-image-work.md)
removed them with the programs that read them. The last commit that holds them is
`1fba91fed6f22cd5aeb4d56d836cf109de48b8ad`, so Git history restores the exact files:
`git show 1fba91fe:aleppo/aleppo-pages/270r.jpg`, for example, gives leaf 270 recto. The
Internet Archive item below can supply a fresh copy.

The images were downloaded from the Internet Archive item
[aleppo-codex](https://archive.org/details/aleppo-codex) using the
BookReader API at scale=2.

## Source

- **Internet Archive item:** `aleppo-codex`
- **Download script:** `py/main_ac_download_pages.py`, retired with the images;
  `git show 1fba91fe:py/main_ac_download_pages.py` recovers it. It was codex-index-aleppo's
  `py/download_aleppo_pages.py` until 2026-08-22.
- **API endpoint:** `https://ia601801.us.archive.org/BookReader/BookReaderImages.php`
- **Source format:** JP2 (JPEG 2000) inside `Aleppo Codex_jp2.zip`
- **Downloaded format:** JPEG (server-side conversion at scale=2)

## Scope

Pages 270r through 281v, 24 in all, covering the Book of Job in the
Aleppo Codex, and 13 more pages: 001r through 006r, and 148r and 148v.

## Naming convention

Each file was named `{leaf}{side}.jpg`, where `{leaf}` is the leaf number
and `{side}` is `r` (recto) or `v` (verso).  For the Job leaves, which
all come after the extra leaf 241a, the archive.org page number for a
leaf is computed as:

    page = (leaf − 1) × 2 + 2 + (0 for recto, 1 for verso)

## Attribution

The Aleppo Codex images are hosted on the Internet Archive.  Users
should consult the Internet Archive item page for current terms and
attribution requirements.
